title: MoveTestPanel: after api.move throws, Move stays disabled and the rejection escapes
evidence: Found 2026-11-25: closed PR 1781's pin P3 (api.move throws) fails on main. widget-src/src/components/MoveTestPanel.tsx:177 sets saving, :180 awaits api.move, and a throw skips setSaving(false) (:181), so Move and Cancel stay disabled (:193-194) and press() (called as void press()) leaves the rejection unhandled. Remedy: the panel's mode as one union whose save step settles on a throw, with P3 as the failing test first.
